title: DeepSeek's Free AI Coding Agent Answers in Your Team Chat
description:
DeepSeek has open-sourced Super-Agent, a research-prototype AI coding agent (released Oct 31, MIT licence).
It works on one GitHub repo, can listen to team chat, and acts only when asked or when a team rule allows it.

Sources:
- https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh-superagent-prototype
